lane: B3 — is this test connected to the reported bug
executor: evidence-run.yml with ref and baseline, runner capture wrapping the suite
does_not_cover: whether the test notices the mechanism later regressing — that is mutation-power
bugs whose reproduction needs timing, a device, or an environment the harness lacks

nodes.check: base is merge_base_commit.sha from the compare endpoint, not the base branch tip
nodes.why: the base branch tip moves; a re-run weeks later is a different experiment

nodes.run: the new test at the merge base
nodes.expect: fails, and the failure message names the assertion that encodes the bug
on_fail: passes — the test is not connected to the reported behaviour
fails on a load or fixture error — the test cannot run there, nothing is falsified

nodes.run: the same test at head, same command, same filter

nodes.expect: passes at head; the base failure is an assertion, not an import
